title: LLM latency spike

top_hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM provider or local model latency increased during chat generation.

evidence.observation: avg5m rose above 5s lab fallback threshold during the incident window
current latency exceeded the 30m 3-sigma upper band

root_cause: The incident pattern matches slow LLM generation rather than retrieval or API routing.
recommended_actions: Check current LLM provider health and latency.
Temporarily route to fallback model or reduce max output tokens.
Keep the LLM latency anomaly panel visible during mitigation.
